note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 4659 Section 3.2.1.1 ('When the IPv6 VPN traffic is to be transported to the BGP speaker using IPv6 tunneling ..., the BGP speaker SHALL advertise a Next Hop Network Address field containing a VPN-IPv6 address - whose 8-octet RD is set to zero, and - whose 16-octet IPv6 address is set to the global IPv6 address of the advertising BGP speaker.') after export-chain next-hop unification (cabc8c511e / c2d7117d05). Verified changes: TestRFC4659LinkLocalPeeringPreservesUnspecifiedGlobalPair switched only NextHopMode=NextHopUnchanged to setExportNextHopUnchanged(ExportPolicy), preserving both cached and rs rails, the valid 48-octet link-local-only peering exception (zero-RD :: + zero-RD link-local), and all 8 invalid controls via egressNextHopWithheld. Unchanged units TestUpdateBuilder_BuildVPN_IPv6_NextHop and TestRFC4659ConfiguredIPv6TransportNextHopWire continue to verify exact 24-octet zero-RD + speaker-owned global IPv6 on wire frames. {single-polarity: positive} remains valid for sender emission under operator-selected IPv6 transport policy.
